name: hazel_weir_velocity_procedural_graph
description: Optimized Procedural Graph featuring front-loaded 20-24 plot land scaling frozen at Day 10, strict Day 3 transition to hyper-fertilized Strawberries, proactive watering can top-offs to eliminate regrowth freezes, elevated >= 0.88x liquidation floors with early-game liquidity bypass, and a post-Day 10 Carrot ban to protect late-game compounding.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, active shop contract demand, total plot count, contiguous layout metrics, and oracle price drop signals across market commodities.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces dynamic cash reserve locks after hour 18 and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation with true livestock-scaled feed reserves (n_animals * 3) to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Fulfills active town shop contracts for 2.0x-3.5x premiums. Prioritizes existing shed inventory and rapid Carrots (max 2 plots) while strictly barring slow single-harvest crops after Day 5 and banning Carrot purchases after Day 10, ensuring >= 90% of land compounds hyper-fertilized Strawberries.

nodes.name: Capital Velocity & Liquidation
nodes.description: Abolishes shed hoarding by executing continuous batch liquidations of uncontracted surplus at dynamic price floors (>= 0.88x base normal; >= 0.82x hard minimum on expansion days <= 10 or when shed fullness >= 50%), cross-checking against town shop demand and preserving crop margins on recurring flushes.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Reads 96-step TTM forecast to dump sensitive commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) only when glut risk is acute (risk >= 0.52, price >= 0.82x base) before opponent dumping collapses market prices.

nodes.name: Capital Reinvestment & Yield Scaling
nodes.description: Reinvests surplus cash into synchronized workforce and land scaling (14 plots by Day 6; 20-24 contiguous plots by Day 9-10; hard land freeze at Day 10), decoupling daytime reinvestment (1.0x payroll) to accelerate hyper-fertilized Strawberry compounding with a Day 22 procurement cutoff.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes field routines with strict micro-dispatch sequencing: proactive watering can top-offs, in-situ harvest-and-water recurring crops, soil preparation and pre-seed hyper-fertilization, cluster harvesting up to backpack capacity, cluster watering, shed drop-off, livestock feeding, and planting.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases; schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21; enforce emergency liquidation of unreserved, non-shop surplus inventory starting at hour 20 to guarantee payroll before midnight.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 3); never hoard phantom wheat when n_animals == 0; never liquidate crops committed to active town shop delivery; do not trigger emergency liquidation before hour 18 during normal daytime production.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and (shop_deliverable_inventory > 0 or (net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.25 + 50.0 and active_shop_demand > 0 and day <= 24)) and day <= 30
attributes.guidance: Allocate market slots to deliver exact matching inventory to town shops for 2.0x-3.5x premium through step 710. Cross-check unreserved Strawberry and Carrot inventory against active Town Shop demand to capture premiums before open-market liquidation. Fulfill orders immediately from existing shed inventory (including Strawberries, Milk, Wool, Carrots). Strictly condition seed procurement on: 1) day + crop_growth_days <= 28; 2) no slow single-harvest crops (Pumpkin, Tomato, Cauliflower, Potato) after Day 5; 3) cap rapid Carrot shop acreage to at most 2 plots, preserving >= 90% acreage for hyper-fertilized Strawberries; 4) hard seed procurement cutoff at Day 24.
attributes.pitfalls: Never purchase or plant slow crops (Pumpkin, Tomato, Potato, Cauliflower) after Day 5, as they cannibalize high-yielding Strawberry flushes for a minor one-off premium. Ban Carrot purchases after Day 10 (except for micro-fulfillments of <= 2 plots for immediate shop contracts). Do not completely abandon fast Carrot shop fulfillment or shed arbitrage, as that forfeits lucrative 2.0x-3.5x premiums to opponents. Never buy shop seeds if net available cash is below 1.25x midnight payroll. Do not hoard uncontracted surplus speculatively.

attributes.condition: uncontracted_surplus_inventory >= 8 or shed_used >= 30 or (day <= 10 and uncontracted_surplus_inventory >= 2)
attributes.guidance: Execute batch sales of unreserved, non-shop surplus holdings at dynamic price floors: maintain >= 0.88x base price during standard operations (shed < 50%). Permit sales down to a hard minimum of 0.82x base price strictly on expansion days <= 10 to unlock fluid capital, or when shed fullness exceeds 50%. Cross-check unreserved Strawberry and Carrot inventory against active Town Shop demand to capture 2.0x-3.5x contract premiums before any open-market liquidation can execute. Defend a strict minimum liquidation floor of 0.88x base on mature compounding days (Day 11-28). Conduct terminal shed clearance strictly between steps 708-716 at a defended >= 0.74x floor.
attributes.pitfalls: Never dump bulk Strawberry harvests at sub-0.88x base price after Day 10 unless shed fullness exceeds 85%. Never liquidate Wheat below dynamic feed reserve (n_animals * 3). Never liquidate exact item quotas reserved for active town shop contracts. Avoid premature terminal fire-sales before step 708.

attributes.guidance: Preempt lowest-margin open orders; execute rapid batch liquidations of vulnerable commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) only when oracle_glut_risk >= 0.52 and current_price >= 0.82 * base_price before opponent dumping collapses market prices.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not front-run on hypersensitive or weak glut signals (risk < 0.52); never dump into collapsed sub-0.82 base price markets unless shed overflow is imminent; do not front-run commodities committed to active town shop contracts.

attributes.condition: ((hour < 18 and net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.0 + 50.0) or (hour >= 18 and net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.5 + 100.0)) and (hired_hands < 11 or (total_plots < 24 and day <= 10) or uncultivated_plots > 0 or has_fertilizer_deficit) and day <= 26
attributes.guidance: Scale workforce dynamically alongside contiguous land: reach 14 plots and 6-7 hands by Day 6, and 20-24 contiguous plots and 10-11 hands by Day 9-10 (~2.0-2.2 plots/hand). Enforce a hard land expansion freeze at Day 10. Decouple daytime reinvestment between hours 04:00-17:00 by requiring only 1.0x payroll reserve + action cost. Restrict Carrots strictly to a single bootstrap cycle (Days 1-3). On Day 3 morning, channel 100% of liquid proceeds into pre-seed hyper-fertilizer and Strawberry seeds. Never plant a second cycle of Carrots on core acreage. Enforce a hard Strawberry seed and fertilizer procurement cutoff at Day 22.
attributes.pitfalls: Never purchase plots after Day 10 as late land expansion yields negative ROI. Never expand land when cash is below daytime reserve (1.0x payroll + plot cost before hour 18, 1.5x after hour 18). Never purchase Strawberry seeds or fertilizer after Day 22. Ban Carrot purchases after Day 10 (except <= 2 plots for immediate shop contracts). Do not plant slow single-harvest crops on expanding acreage.

attributes.guidance: Dispatch hands following strict micro-dispatch priority: 1) Proactive Watering Can Top-offs (hands must refill at the well whenever water falls below 30% *before* starting a harvest pass), 2) In-situ Harvest & Immediate Water recurring crops (guaranteeing 100% of ripe Strawberry harvests are immediately watered in-situ on the exact same tick), 3) Soil Preparation & Pre-Seed Hyper-Fertilization (apply fertilizer to tilled soil before seeding to ensure all Strawberries are hyper-fertilized), 4) Cluster Harvest adjacent ripe plots up to backpack capacity, 5) Cluster Watering of any remaining dry cultivated plots to eliminate regrowth halts, 6) Shed Drop-off (when backpack full or hour >= 20; guarantee all carried goods deposited by step 716), 7) Livestock Feeding, 8) Planting seeds (hyper-fertilized Strawberries primary; max 2 Carrot plots for active shops), 9) Till/Weed new plots.
attributes.pitfalls: Never allow Strawberry plots to remain unwatered post-harvest, as dry intervals freeze regrowth clocks. Never start a harvest pass with < 30% water capacity. Never plant Strawberry seeds on unfertilized plots; always apply fertilizer prior to seed placement. Do not drop off at shed with partially full backpacks unless hour >= 20 or approaching step 716. Never create dispatch deadlocks if an action cannot be performed immediately; gracefully fall through priority chain. Ensure no hand idles while harvestable crops or dry plots exist. Keep 100% of mature Strawberry acreage watered and compounding through terminal shed clearance at steps 712-716.
